shared_elements: suggestion of a face or figure with eyes
justification: Both surfaces bear carved relief imagery that includes rounded eye-like or spiral discs and something resembling a face, but that is the extent of the correspondence. A shows a single naturalistically proportioned standing human in strict profile holding a long spear and bow, with elaborately rendered pleated robe, beard and headdress, whereas B shows a cluster of schematic, heavily stylised curvilinear motifs (concentric circles, blobby masks, hooked forms) crowded over a boulder with no coherent standing figure, no held objects and no linear register.
